title: 第14章 再见师妹，焚髓剑煞
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

时光飞逝，眨眼之间，又到了一日黄昏。

陆玄在精舍之中睁眼，眼中闪过一丝无奈。

“两日时光，还是太短了，想要修行《乾元六龙御天真经》上的玄门正法，时间根本不够……”

想要增幅手段，提升战力，首先要修的，自然就是新得的真经。

陆玄在精舍之中苦坐许久，将《乾元六龙御天真经》细细参悟了一番，虽然收获颇丰，对接下来的修行采炁有了更深的理解，但想要修行其上记载的玄门秘术，时间却根本不够。

这大日真经上所记载的都是煌煌正法，威能不俗，但修行起来亦要水磨之功，不是那般容易的。

入阳燧洞之争，确实莽撞了一些。

“但……也不是没有法子。”

“炼炁乃是修行第二境，正如蛰院教习所说，人之肉身，乃是最原始之器，若是双方斗法，炁皆用尽，难不成只能坐以待毙？自然要以拳脚刀剑，分出胜负。”

“故此，在胎息之境，前身学拳习剑，搏击之术已是上乘之境……”

陆玄心中思索，同时起身，来到院中，取出了一柄精铁长剑，随手舞动起来。

霎时间，剑光灿灿，如银蛇游动，映得院中一片霜寒。

陆玄伸出双指，在剑身之上轻轻一抹，霎时间，院中光线齐齐凝聚，化为灿灿火光，附在剑身之上。

“轰！”

陆玄抬步举剑，剑势顿时一变，大开大合，刚猛爆裂，似有重岳摧崩之力。

配合剑上之火光，一时间，院中火影摇曳，似蛟龙怒吼，炙热滚烫，令人生畏。

不仅如此，剑身一片灿灿，似日光耀眼，令人不敢直视。

“我虽然不曾习得术法，没有开窍，但聚炁成火，凝炁于剑，乃是本能，配合这胎息境的《巡天剑法》，也别有一番威势……”

“不仅如此，我炁如大日，附着于剑，有灿灿之辉，可摄人眼目，只是不知，和那明猿目中火轮相比如何……”

“除此之外，我还可云炁化光，瞬息抽身……”

陆玄挥动长剑，身影如光，刹那之间飞旋上天，而后又猛然扑下，其速度之快之灵活，早已超越凡人之躯。

毕竟他会飞。

“轰！”

不仅如此，陆玄心念一动，方圆丈许之地，炁流涌动，瞬息形成巨大的推力和灼热感，似乎有一堵无形之墙，挡在了他的前方。

凝炁成墙！

又一无需术法的炼炁基本能力。

这炁强刚猛，万钧之力难摧。

除此之外，还有以炁化力，凭空摄人、袭人等小手段。

陆玄都一一试了。

相比胎息之境，强横了不知多少，已非凡人手段。

“若是对付寻常炼炁初成的妖族、火煞，当是够了，但明猿传承多代，虽非大族，可底蕴定是有的，那阳燧洞也甚是凶险……”

“没有法术，还是不够……”

“为今之计，只有另辟蹊径了……”

陆玄检验己身，还是觉得不保险。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, it’s dusk again.

Lu Xuan opened his eyes in the monastery, with a trace of helplessness flashing in his eyes.

"Two days are still too short. If you want to practice the Xuanmen Dharma in the "Qianyuan Six Dragons Yu Tianzhen Sutra", there is simply not enough time..."

If you want to increase your means and improve your combat power, the first thing you need to practice is naturally the newly acquired scriptures.

Lu Xuan sat hard in the monastery for a long time, studying the "Qianyuan Six Dragons Yu Tianzhen Jing" in detail. Although he gained a lot and had a deeper understanding of the next practice of collecting Qi, he still didn't have enough time to practice the Xuanmen secrets recorded in it.

What is recorded in the Great Sun Sutra is the splendid Dharma, and its power is extraordinary, but its practice requires hard work and is not that easy.

The fight over entering Yangsui Cave was indeed a bit reckless.

"But...it's not impossible."

"Refining qi is the second level of cultivation. As the teachings of the Hidden Garden say, the human body is the most primitive weapon. If both sides use up their qi in a fight, is it possible that they can only sit back and wait for death? Naturally, the winner will be determined by fists, feet, and swords."

"Therefore, in the realm of fetal breath, my predecessor learned boxing and swordsmanship, and the fighting skills were already in a superior state..."

Lu Xuan thought in his heart, got up at the same time, came to the courtyard, took out a fine iron long sword, and started to dance casually.

In an instant, the sword was shining brightly, like a silver snake swimming, reflecting the frost in the courtyard.

Lu Xuan stretched out his two fingers and lightly touched the sword body. In an instant, the light in the courtyard condensed and turned into brilliant firelight, clinging to the sword body.

"Boom!"

Lu Xuan stepped forward and raised his sword. The power of the sword suddenly changed. It opened and closed, and exploded with force, as if it had the power to destroy Zhongyue.

Coupled with the firelight on the sword, for a moment, the fire shadow in the courtyard swayed, like a dragon roaring, hot and frightening.

Not only that, the blade of the sword was as bright as the sun, making people afraid to look directly at it.

"Although I have never learned any techniques and have no enlightenment, gathering energy into fire and condensing energy into swords are instinctive. The "Xuntian Sword Art" that matches the fetal breath realm also has a special power..."

"Not only that, I am as strong as the sun, attached to the sword, with a brilliant brilliance that can catch people's eyes, but I don't know how it compares with the fire wheel in the bright ape's eyes..."

"Besides that, I can also use Yun Qi to turn into light and escape instantly..."

Lu Xuan waved his long sword, and his figure was like light, spinning up to the sky in an instant, and then suddenly pounced down. His speed and flexibility had long surpassed that of a mortal.

He can fly after all.

"Boom!"

Not only that, Lu Xuan thought about it, and in a square meter of land, the energy flow surged, instantly forming a huge thrust and burning sensation, as if there was an invisible wall blocking his way.

Condensation energy forms a wall!

Another basic ability to refine Qi that does not require magic.

This Qi is so strong and powerful that it is indestructible.

In addition, there are also small methods such as using energy to transform people, absorbing people out of thin air, and attacking people.

Lu Xuan tried them all one by one.

Compared with the realm of fetal breath, it is much more tyrannical, and it is no longer ordinary people's means.

"It would be enough to deal with the ordinary demons and fire evil spirits who have just begun to refine Qi. However, Ming Yuan has been passed down for many generations. Although it is not a big family, it must have some background. The Yang Sui Cave is also very dangerous..."

"Without magic, it's still not enough..."

"For the current plan, we can only find another way..."

Lu Xuan checked himself and still felt that it was not safe.
